title: IN between a number and a table of text is an error, not FALSE

expected.error: the number 1 cannot be compared with the text column of the table

source.quote: If a Value has a data type that cannot be compared with the corresponding column, CONTAINSROW returns an error. For example, the number 1 does not match the text “1”.
source.supports: a number against a text column is an error

derivation: The table constructor has one text column and the value tested is a number. The page says such a comparison makes CONTAINSROW, which IN runs, return an error.
alternative: The example sentence says the number 1 "does not match" the text "1", which can also be read as a FALSE result. In that reading the query returns one row with FALSE.
